section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses for a single study (no 'Study 1' label is used). It reports a final sample of 215 and details data screening procedures including single imputation for missing data, outlier detection and winsorization, transformations for skewness, tests for homoscedasticity/linearity, and centering of BAS and MBSRQ scores prior to regression.
